languageResolution.normalize: trim, lowercase, replace underscore with hyphen; then en or en-* maps to en, zh or zh-* maps to zh, otherwise zh
readOrder: explicit query parameter lang when present (even empty) is normalized
otherwise Accept-Language when present and non-blank: first language range with weight > 0 that is supported; a parse failure or no supported range yields zh with NO X-App-Language fallback
X-App-Language is consulted only when Accept-Language is absent or blank, then normalized; absent yields zh
writeOrder: body language field when non-null is normalized
otherwise the same fromHeaders order as read

endpoints.request: JSON {username, password}. username accepts username or email; if it contains @ it is looked up as email (lowercased) among non-deleted users, otherwise as exact username.
endpoints.success: 200 ApiResponse {code:0, message:"ok", data:UserResponse{publicId,username,nickname,email,avatarUrl,pronouns,signature}}. Rotates session id, sets maxInactiveInterval, stores userId/username/email/role/sessionVersion, clears adminSecondVerified/adminSecondVerifiedAt.
errors: 401 ApiResponse {code:4001, message:"Invalid username or password"} when user missing or password mismatch
401 JSON {"message":"Spring Security Error"} is not used here because route is permitAll
endpoints.notes: Legacy non-bcrypt stored password (not $2a$/$2b$/$2y$ and not starting with {) is compared literally then upgraded to bcrypt on success; hash-looking values never fall back to literal compare.

endpoints.request: JSON {username, nickname, email, password, website}. website is a honeypot.
endpoints.success: 200 ApiResponse {code:0, message:"ok", data:UserResponse}. Rotates session id and logs the new user in immediately.
errors: 400 ApiResponse {code:4004, message:"注册请求无效"} when website is non-blank
429 ApiResponse {code:429, message:"请求过于频繁，请稍后再试"} when per-IP rate limit exceeded (default 5 attempts / 600s)
400 ApiResponse {code:4002, message:"Username or email already exists"} when username empty, email empty, password length < 4, or username/email already taken
endpoints.notes: Client IP from X-Forwarded-For first hop, else remoteAddr. Nickname defaults to trimmed username when blank. Email lowercased. Role USER.

endpoints.success: 200 ApiResponse {code:0, message:"ok", data:UserResponse}.
errors: 401 ApiResponse {code:401, message:"未登录"} when no session userId or user not found; user-not-found also clears userId/username/email/role from session

endpoints.request: Path id must be numeric (SecurityConfig permitAll only matches /api/markers/[0-9]+).
endpoints.success: 200 MapMarker JSON, localized by MarkerLocalizationAdvice.

endpoints.request: JSON MarkerCreateRequest {lat, lng, category, title, description, language, isPublic(default true), isActive(default true), openTimeStart, openTimeEnd, clientRequestId, markImage}.
endpoints.success: 200 MapMarker JSON (not 201). New marker has reviewStatus=PENDING, isPublic default true, isActive default true, sourceLanguage = normalize(body language) when non-null, else fromHeaders (Accept-Language when present and non-blank, otherwise X-App-Language, otherwise zh); only zh/en are accepted.
errors: 401 text "请先登录" when session/user missing
400 text "缺少必要字段" when lat, lng, category or title is null
400 text category validation message when unsupported; legacy safe_place/dangerous_place map to self_definition; supported: accessible_toilet, friendly_clinic, baby_room, self_definition
400 text "clientRequestId 过长" when trimmed clientRequestId longer than 64
400 text "markImage 只能为空，请通过图片上传提交" when markImage is present and not blank
409 ApiResponse {code:409, message:"数据已更新，请刷新后重试"} only if an optimistic lock exception surfaces
endpoints.notes: Idempotent via clientRequestId + unique constraint (user_public_id, client_request_id); replay returns the existing marker with 200. Security tighten (2026-09-14): new markers may only omit or blank markImage; images must be attached through the upload proposal and review flow, preventing a caller from forging a reference to someone else's private image. The check runs in the first full validation of the write core, so no other entry point bypasses it; clientRequestId replays still return the existing marker unchanged.

endpoints.success: 200 JSON array of MapMarker where isPublic=true and reviewStatus=APPROVED.
endpoints.notes: No explicit ordering; not a stable sort contract.

endpoints.success: 200 JSON array of MapMarker. Merged from source title/description/category/lat/lng matches, translation title/description matches with valid source hash, and coordinate matches within 0.00015 degrees when q parses as 'lat,lng'.
endpoints.notes: Blank q returns []. Results localized. Deduplicated by marker id.

endpoints.request: Query lat, lng, radius (default 1000), category (default accessible_toilet).
endpoints.success: 200 JSON array of MapMarker, isPublic=true, APPROVED, matching category, ordered by spherical distance ascending. Radius clamped to 1..50000 meters.
errors: 400 text "缺少 lat/lng 参数" when lat or lng missing
400 text "lat/lng 不合法" when lat/lng out of range
400 text category validation message when unsupported category, or "边界参数不合法" for invalid window
500 text "数据库未启用 PostGIS，请先执行：CREATE EXTENSION postgis;" when a PostGIS-related SQL error surfaces
endpoints.notes: Redis cache key prefix cache:marker:nearby:v1:, default TTL 12s; cached entries re-checked against current DB visibility. Current implementation uses bounding box plus Haversine, not PostGIS.

endpoints.request: Query minLat, maxLat, minLng, maxLng (required), categories (optional comma-separated).
endpoints.success: 200 JSON array of MapMarker, isPublic=true, APPROVED, within bounds, matching any requested category.
errors: 400 text "缺少视口边界参数" when a bound is missing
400 text "边界参数不合法" when minLat > maxLat or minLng > maxLng
400 text "边界超出合法经纬度范围" when bounds outside [-90,90]/[-180,180]
endpoints.notes: Redis cache prefix cache:marker:viewport:v1:, default TTL 10s. Empty categories means no category filter.

endpoints.request: Path directory must be avatars or markers; filename must match [A-Za-z0-9_.-]+ and have extension jpg/jpeg/png/gif/webp.
endpoints.success: 200 raw image with mapped Content-Type, header X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Cache-Control: no-store.
errors: 404 empty body for unknown directory, disallowed filename/extension, path traversal, missing/non-regular file, or inaccessible marker image
endpoints.notes: Marker image is readable when a marker with this markImage is viewable by the viewer, or when a matching imageUrl proposal's related marker exists and the viewer is ADMIN, the marker owner (publicId equals marker.userPublicId), or the proposal submitter (publicId equals proposal.proposerPublicId) while the marker is viewable. Proposal status is NOT checked (no status=PENDING condition). Private or unreadable marker images return 404, not 403.
